7021.rankDhahabiEn: One of the eminent scholars. Ahmad said: Khurasan has not produced the likes of him after Ibn al-Mubarak. Ibn Rahwayh said: I have not seen the likes of him, nor has he seen the likes of himself. A firm authority, a jurist, a master of Hadith, though not very prolific
